text:
Joan L.: quick heads-up — finishing the quick-eval pack for Hummingbird finetune (cust HMB-42). Ran the adapter merge + int4 quant probe, and we see token-level amount drift on financial prompts. sharing short summary below.

Ravi P.: can you paste the eval id and the top metrics? also which tokenizer version?

Joan L.: eval id: hmb-qpack-042. tokenizer: v2.1 (we applied the customer's special_tokens). top-line: EM down 8.6%, numeric-exact down 14% on invoice set. overall rouge/bertscore ~stable.

Marco: do you have a repro snippet? want to run locally and check cache behavior.

Joan L.: repro command:
```
python tools/run_quick_eval.py 
  --model hummingbird/merged-finetune:v2 
  --adapter adapters/hmb42-lora.safetensors 
  --quant int4 
  --tokenizer tokenizer-v2.1 
  --dataset tests/hmb_invoices.jsonl 
  --out out/hmb_qpack_results.json
```
(we used the smoke prompt set: 120 examples, mostly amounts + dates)

eval-bot: quick results for hmb-qpack-042 (int4):
- exact_amount_accuracy: 0.71 (baseline int8=0.85)
- em: 0.67 (baseline=0.73)
- rouge_l: 0.81 (baseline=0.82)
- note: failures concentrate on numbers with commas and trailing currency codes ("1,200" vs "1200 USD")

Sam: interesting — smells like tokenizer merge or LoRA scaling interacting with quant. two quick checks: 1) run int8 on same pack, 2) test running merged model but with original base tokenizer (no special_tokens) to isolate tokenization effect.

Ravi P.: +1. also try running with `--disable-kv-cache` just to rule out stale KV packing affecting decoding.

Marco: i ran the command locally (cpu fallback) and reproduced a couple cases. example input: "Invoice total: 1,200.00 USD" -> model output: "Invoice total: 1200.0" (missing USD) — that's the numeric formatting shift we saw.

Joan L.: action plan:
- I will run int8 smoke + original-tokenizer run (today EOD).
- Marco to run `--disable-kv-cache` and share 20 failing examples.
- Ravi to open tiny PR to try preserving `special_tokens` normalization in tokenizer merge (possible off-by-one tokenization on comma).

Sam: if int8 matches baseline, fallback policy = auto-route HMB-42 to int8 for production canary and run full eval suite. if int8 still off, we need to re-run adapter merge with token-map alignment (or re-tokenize dataset).

Joan L.: will post results here once int8 finish. thanks all :thumbsup:

Ravi P.: FYI tagging infra: @eval-bot please trigger follow-up regression job `hmb-regress-full` if Joan posts int8 pass.

eval-bot: noted — will queue `hmb-regress-full` if requested.

Marco: uploaded 20 failing examples to `gs://redwood-dev/hmb/qpack-042/fails.jsonl` — link: https://storage.cloud/hmb/qpack-042/fails.jsonl

Joan L.: got it, thx!
